units.rationale: PreparationSpec at regression_preparation_adapter.py:528-534 uses preflight audio-fixtures (host.preflight@1 choices at OperationSpec 2229) and import_staged True for REGRESSION_FIXTURE_SETS[audio-only]: internal-fate-alac-cover-art-v1 -> inside.m4a, internal-fate-dts-es-v1 -> dts_es.dts, internal-fate-truehd-atmos-v1 -> atmos.thd, internal-fate-vorbis-v1 -> 1.0-test_small.ogg, all present under TestMedia. The 15 catalog calls match the adapter: session/reset, then stage-plus-import pairs via media.stage-fixture@2:2305 and media.import-staged@2:2306, closed by library.snapshot@1:2355 and harness.assert-channels@2:2218. journey_preflight.py audio-fixtures is the host driver. Output audio-only-fixtures-ready / fixture-set.audio-only@2 is unique on device; OperationSpec.validate accepted every call.

PreparationSpec at regression_preparation_adapter.py:572-576 imports the ten dynamic-range STAGEABLE_FIXTURES, including generated-hlg-hevc10-avsync-10s-v1, generated-pq-hevc10-avsync-10s-v1, internal-dolby-vision-p5-hd-v1, p7-fel, p81-hdr10, p84-hlg, p100/p101/p104 AV1, and internal-apple-dolby-vision-p20-3d-v1, each on disk under TestMedia. The 26 catalog calls are session/reset plus stage-plus-import pairs then library.snapshot@1:2355; tags include display.capture because later scenarios capture, not because this setup itself needs a wearer. HC-002 is decided, so HDR/Dolby Vision uses exact metadata and references rather than subjective brightness. All 26 calls validate on the device lane and produce dynamic-range-corpus-ready / fixture-set.dynamic-range@2.

PreparationSpec at regression_preparation_adapter.py:577-581 lists the single catalog call host.preflight@1 check=emby-aggregate (OperationSpec 2221/2230). execute_plan at 1843-1935 then runs ResidentEmbyAccountPreparationRoute.prepare (1588), which calls ensure-session, copies Tests/EmbyPackageTests/Fixtures/EmbyServerCredentials.local.json (present, 250 bytes) into the app container, and sends app-command verb prepareEmbyAccount; that is a current device-lane controller path, not a future proposal. Output emby-test-library-ready / remote-source.emby-library@2 carries tags emby.account and source.emby.fixture-revision. semantic-authority.json sets runtimeHumanActorAllowed false, so the owned credentials file is the account binding rather than a hidden prompt.

PreparationSpec at regression_preparation_adapter.py:582-587 sets preflight remote-faults and connect_webdav True, producing faultable-remote-source-ready / remote-source.faultable@2 with tags certificate.trust, network.fault, and source.webdav. The 16 catalog calls match the WebDAV connect sequence after host.preflight@1 check=remote-faults (OperationSpec 2221; REMOTE_PREFLIGHT_CHECKS includes remote-faults, and _host_preflight allows later activate/restore recipes). Credentials come from .build/regression-remote-source/runtime.json; inspect requires FileBrowsing-grid-video-sdr-bframe-aggregate-30s.mkv. There are no staged fixture_ids because the host owns the aggregate files. All 16 calls validate on device and retry is reconstructible after reset-product-state@2.

PreparationSpec at regression_preparation_adapter.py:588-592 imports REGRESSION_FIXTURE_SETS[format-corpus] (13 ids). FORMAT_CORPUS_REQUIRED_FIXTURES at 472-481 (generated-sdr-avc-bframe-audio-codec-matrix-15s-v1, internal-fate-dts-es-v1, internal-fate-truehd-atmos-v1, internal-fate-vorbis-v1, internal-apple-apmp-180-v1, internal-apple-mvhevc-short-v1, internal-fate-mpeg4-part2-packed-bframes-v1) is a subset of that set, and every file exists under TestMedia. The 32 catalog calls are session/reset plus stage-plus-import pairs via media.stage-fixture@2:2305 and media.import-staged@2:2306, closed by library.snapshot@1:2355. Tags include audio.capture. HC-007 is decided and does not block this corpus. All 32 calls validate on device and produce format-corpus-ready / fixture-set.format-corpus@2.

PreparationSpec at regression_preparation_adapter.py:593-598 shares the remote-faults plus WebDAV connect sequence with faultable-remote-source but writes a distinct output issue-fixtures-ready / fixture-set.issue-surfaces@2 and tags issue.surface plus certificate.trust. The 16 catalog calls still resolve to host.preflight@1:2221, accessibility.activate@2:2189 (FileBrowsing-SourcesSidebar-addWebDAV, FileBrowsing-CertificateTrust-trust, label 以后), accessibility.type@2:2217 against runtime.json, and accessibility.inspect@2:2191 of FileBrowsing-grid-video-sdr-bframe-aggregate-30s.mkv. No extra fixture ids are required because the issue surface is that connected faultable host. All 16 calls validate on device.

PreparationSpec at regression_preparation_adapter.py:535-539 is the device-lane twin of local-aggregate-simulator: same LOCAL_AGGREGATE_FIXTURES (seven ids including generated-sdr-avc-bframe-multiaudio-subtitles-30s-v3 and generated-sdr-avc-bframe-duplicate-label-audio-30s-v1), import_staged false, output local-aggregate-staged / fixture-set.local-aggregate-staged@2 unique on this lane. The 11 catalog calls match _materialize_calls and OperationSpec.validate accepted them on device, using media.stage-fixture@2:2305 with sourceRoot /Volumes/Cortisol/DevSpace/EnchronWorkspace/TestMedia. harness.reset-product-state@2:2219 with rootFolderName Journey Fixture makes retry reconstruct the staged corpus without a human actor.

PreparationSpec at regression_preparation_adapter.py:540-548 carries DirectorySourceBinding directory_name sdr-bframe-aggregate-30s-sidecars over LOCAL_DIRECTORY_SUBTITLE_FIXTURES. After staging generated-sdr-avc-bframe-aggregate-30s-v1, the zh-CN SubRip sidecar, and the styled ASS sidecar, call 08 is operation:preparation.local-directory-subtitle-source@1 (OperationSpec 2307) with mediaFileName sdr-bframe-aggregate-30s.mkv and memberFileNames [sdr-bframe-aggregate-30s.mkv, sdr-bframe-aggregate-30s.zh-CN.srt, sdr-bframe-aggregate-30s.styled.ass]. execute_plan at 1826-1842 requires the typed directoryMediaImportReceipt before producing local-directory-subtitle-source-ready / media-source.local-directory-sidecars@1. All eight calls validate on device.

PreparationSpec at regression_preparation_adapter.py:599-605 is the device-lane twin of presentation-fixtures-simulator: same three fixtures generated-sdr-avc-bframe-multiaudio-avsync-120s-v1, internal-spatial-180-sbs-v1 (180_3D.mp4), internal-spatial-360-mono-v1 (360.mp4), import_staged True, connect_webdav True, preflight webdav-regression. The 24 catalog calls match the adapter, including media.import-staged@2:2306 and the WebDAV credential/trust/inspect sequence ending at FileBrowsing-grid-video-sdr-bframe-aggregate-30s.mkv. Output presentation-fixtures-ready / fixture-set.presentation-tour@2 is unique on the device lane. All 24 calls validate on device; HC-001 remains a decided pre-run permission, not a runtime prompt.

PreparationSpec at regression_preparation_adapter.py:613-617 imports REGRESSION_FIXTURE_SETS[projection-stereo]: internal-apple-dolby-vision-p20-3d-v1, internal-spatial-180-sbs-v1, internal-spatial-180-tb-v1, internal-spatial-360-mono-v1, internal-apple-mvhevc-short-v1, internal-apple-apmp-180-v1, internal-apple-apmp-360-v1, and internal-apple-immersive-video-beach-v1 -> Immersive-Video-example.f99766.mp4, all on disk. The 22 catalog calls are session/reset plus stage-plus-import pairs via media.stage-fixture@2:2305 and media.import-staged@2:2306. Tags include display.capture for later capture obligations, not a wearer checkpoint. Output projection-corpus-ready / fixture-set.projection-stereo@2; all 22 calls validate on device.

PreparationSpec at regression_preparation_adapter.py:554-559 sets preflight smb-aggregate and connect_smb True, producing smb-test-source-ready / remote-source.smb-fixture@2 with tag source.smb. The 19 catalog calls match _materialize_calls: host.preflight@1:2221, session/reset, then the SMB form FileBrowsing-SourceConnection-smb-* typing address/user/password from .build/regression-smb-source/runtime.json via accessibility.type@2:2217, connect, dismiss 以后, then folder hops FileBrowsing-grid-folder-TestMedia (SHARE_NAME), TestVectors, Enchron, PlaybackBehavior, inspect FileBrowsing-grid-video-sdr-bframe-aggregate-30s.mkv, and a closing smb-aggregate preflight. All 19 calls validate on device; no human prompt is required once the SMB runtime identity exists.

PreparationSpec at regression_preparation_adapter.py:618-625 is the device-lane twin of viewing-storage-fixtures-simulator: five STAGEABLE_FIXTURES including generated-viewing-storage-h264-16m01s-v1 and generated-viewing-storage-h264-16m01s-b-v1, import_staged false, preflight webdav-regression, connect_webdav True, and clear_storage_targets container-index-cache plus playback-progress via storage.clear@1:2372. The 23 catalog calls match the adapter and validate on device. Output viewing-storage-fixtures-ready / fixture-set.viewing-storage@2 carries tags cache.state, viewing.state, and source.webdav; reset-product-state@2 plus restage plus WebDAV reconnect reconstructs the output after retry.
